title: cann-attribution-overlap
summary: Attribute NPU trace kernels to model source and plan bounded multistream overlap: select a representative step, map kernels to source owners via code_ref, build the module/operator dependency DAG (data, state, event, collective-order edges), classify serial/candidate/pending groups, choose minimal-first overlap with an explicit execution-mode synchronization contract, and accept only through correctness-first checks.
